reason: 该插件的主要用途是为 DSH 提供应用内重启自动化，支持通过模型工具或侧边栏按钮触发重启，并在执行前后进行会话协调、失败回滚与任务恢复，属于工作流/运维类控制能力而非内容生产或外部集成工具。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH 插件，用于在应用内发起并管理整体重启，支持按钮或工具触发重启，并在重启前协调忙碌会话、失败回滚后恢复原会话继续任务。
summaries.en: This is a DSH plugin for orchestrating in-app restarts, allowing restarts via a tool or sidebar control, with busy-session coordination, rollback handling, and session recovery after restart.

capabilities: In-app application restart orchestration for DSH
Automatic rollback on restart or initialization failure
Session state recovery and continuation after restart

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as an in-app restart plugin with restart modes, coordination, rollback, and resume behavior.
Package metadata defines a DSH client entry and web platform injection (./client.js, dsh.client), indicating a UI-facing control path in addition to runtime logic.
Repository tree includes lib and docs implementing restart API, client UI button, and troubleshooting docs, consistent with lifecycle control behavior rather than data/content tools.
